name: massfinder
title: Mass finder: mass.dioceseofbrooklyn.org /all (read 2026-11-05)
command: pnpm diocese roster import brooklyn massfinder scratch/brooklyn-map-1/001-survey/massfinder.json
notes: Built by scratch/brooklyn-map-1/tools/massfinder-fetch.sh + massfinder.py: name and coordinates from /all, street address from each /places/<id> page. 173 places, mostly one per parish; merged parishes appear under their combined name with the main church in parentheses. times_listed counts listed times; on several pages the times and notes look like placeholder text (St. Rose of Lima: 'Followed by potluck brunch', a 2:00pm Filipino Mass), so don't trust its schedules without the bulletin.
